headline: Now you can securely link multiple phones to one Signal account
summary: Signal now allows linking multiple phones (Android/iPhone) to a single account. This expands on existing support for PCs and iPads. Users can now check and respond to messages across all linked mobile devices.

headline: AMD's datacenter business is booming while gaming takes a backseat
summary: AMD's datacenter revenue more than doubled year-over-year, reaching $6.7 billion. This surge is primarily driven by high demand for AI capacity. Gaming revenue now takes a secondary role compared to the booming AI sector.

headline: SpaceX made more revenue as an AI company than a space company
summary: SpaceX's AI revenue tripled to $2.6 billion, surpassing its traditional space ventures. Growth comes from providing compute to other AI companies. The AI division is a major revenue source for the company.

headline: EA is now a private company
summary: Electronic Arts has officially transitioned to a private company. The move follows a $55 billion deal led by Saudi Arabia's PIF and other investors. The PIF will reportedly own a significant 93.4% stake in EA.

headline: Spider-Man: Brand New Day Reportedly Cut a Scene With a Fan-Favorite Daredevil Character And It Might've Fixed a Plot Hole
summary: Spider-Man: Brand New Day reportedly cut a scene featuring a popular Daredevil character. This deleted scene could have potentially resolved a minor plot hole. The movie almost included more MCU cameos.

headline: Tom Holland and Zendaya Are On an Unprecedented Box Office Run
summary: Tom Holland and Zendaya are experiencing an exceptional box office streak. Their roles in Spider-Man: Brand New Day and The Odyssey contribute to their success. They are projected to set astonishing box office records this year.

headline: Halo: Campaign Evolved Reportedly Had a Troubled Development That Impacted a Now-Canceled Multiplayer Project
summary: Halo: Campaign Evolved experienced a difficult development period. These issues negatively affected a related, now-canceled multiplayer project. The report details the troubled production of the game.

headline: Oded Fehr Gives First Look at Ardeth Bay in The Mummy 4
summary: Oded Fehr shared a first look at his character, Ardeth Bay, for The Mummy 4. Fehr is reprising his role as the fan-favorite character. Fans get a sneak peek at Ardeth Bay's return after many years.

headline: Video shows Russian drone chasing Ukrainian street vendor in 'human safari' attack
summary: A video depicts a Russian drone pursuing a Ukrainian street vendor. Ukraine condemned the incident as a 'human safari' war crime. The civilian was reportedly hounded by the remotely-controlled drone.

headline: More than 170 migrants rescued after boat catches fire in Channel
summary: Over 170 migrants were rescued after their boat caught fire in the Channel. They were attempting to cross to the UK from France. The UK government states all migrants will be returned to France.

headline: Afghan boxer arrested in Greece over discovery of Scottish woman's body in suitcase
summary: An Afghan boxer was arrested in Greece in connection with a Scottish woman's death. Her body was discovered inside a suitcase. Sharif Ahmadzai is expected to appear in an Athens court soon.

headline: Oil prices fall on hopes Strait of Hormuz could reopen
summary: Oil prices are falling amidst hopes for the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. US officials announced progress in talks to resume shipments. This development could ease global oil supply concerns.
